# Juniper Lantern events and media

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

The Winter Sharing afternoon is Saturday 19 July 2031 at 14:00 in the Courtyard Hall. Families may request up to two spectator seats through the office; the request does not reserve a seat. Rehearsal is Saturday 12 July at 10:00. Students bring plain dark trousers and a water bottle. The studio does not publish student photos without a recorded media consent choice. A student may participate without photo consent. A parent's email request to change consent needs human verification before the record changes.
